blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has improved the capability of language models, directly applying it to Spoken Language Models (SLMs) may introduce long silent intervals under the serial “think-then-speak” paradigm, disrupting real-time spoken interaction.
To address this issue, we propose an asynchronous think-aloud framework for reasoning-based SLMs within the Thinker-Talker architecture.
The framework maintains a primary reasoning stream for logical deduction and a lightweight think-aloud stream that generates short, task-grounded progress utterances conditioned on the user input and the evolving reasoning state. A dynamic balance strategy coordinates the two streams at runtime, triggering additional think-aloud speech to avoid silent gaps and canceling pending utterances when the final response becomes ready. Experiments on spoken reasoning and question-answering benchmarks show that our approach substantially reduces user-audible silence during reasoning while maintaining answer accuracy comparable to that of a serial “think-then-speak” baseline, demonstrating the potential of asynchronous think-aloud for responsive interaction in SLMs.
blocks.zh:
虽然Cain-of-Thought(CoT)推理提高了语言模型的能力,但直接将其应用于Spoken语言模型(SLMS)可能会在序列"思念-当时说"范式下引入长时间的无声间隔,干扰了实时口语互动.
为了解决这一问题,我们建议在 " Thinker-Talker " 架构内为基于推理的可持续土地管理建立一个同步的思维-声音框架。
框架维持一个逻辑推理的主要推理流和一个轻量级的思维-aloud流,生成以用户输入和不断发展的推理状态为条件的短而基于任务的进展语句. 动态平衡战略在运行时协调两条流,触发了额外的思想-声响演说来避免沉默的空隙,并在最后回应准备就绪后取消待发的言论. 关于口头推理和问答基准的实验表明,我们的方法在推理过程中大大减少了用户可以听到的沉默,同时保持了与连续的“思索时语”基线相似的答案准确性,表明同步的思维声在可持续土地管理中进行响应性互动的潜力。

blocks.en:
Human speakers rarely plan an entire response silently before delivering it ( Levelt, 1993 ) .
Instead, they often formulate, revise, and refine ideas within the flow of conversation.
Disfluencies, such as pauses, hedges, and self-corrections, facilitate turn-taking and signal confidence, progress, and intent in real time ( Clark and Fox Tree, 2002 ) .
Speakers also organize content incrementally, often giving a coarse structure before filling in details.
This observation motivates spoken systems that can provide timely feedback while their underlying reasoning is still unfolding.
blocks.zh:
人类的演讲者很少在传达之前默默地规划整个响应(Levelt,1993年).
相反,他们常常在对话流中提出、修改和完善想法。
暂停、套期和自我矫正等差异,有助于实时采取转弯和信号信心、进步和意图(Clark and Fox Tree, 2002.)。
发言者还逐步组织内容,往往在填写细节之前给出粗糙的结构。
这种观察激励了能够及时提供反馈的口语系统,而其基本推理仍在进行。

blocks.en:
Complex reasoning has become a cornerstone of recent LLM research ( Team, 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Jaech et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2022 ) , driving strong performance improvements in mathematical problem-solving and code generation ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2025 ; Jaech et al., 2024 ) .
As spoken language models (SLMs) are increasingly expected to support question answering, tutoring, task-oriented assistance, and other interactive applications, incorporating such reasoning capabilities into speech-based interaction becomes an important next step.
blocks.zh:
复杂推理已成为近期LLM研究的基石(Team,2025;Guo等,2025;Jaech等,2024;Wei等,2022;),推动在数学问题解决和代码生成方面的强效改进(Guo等,2025;Shao等,2025;Jaech等,2024.).
由于人们日益期望口语模式支持回答问题,辅导、面向任务的协助和其他互动应用程序,将这种推理能力纳入以语音为基础的互动成为下一个重要步骤。

blocks.en:
However, reasoning-based spoken interaction introduces a latency-accuracy tension.
A straightforward approach is to perform full textual reasoning before speaking and then generate the final spoken response.
While this serial “think-then-speak” paradigm can preserve the benefits of explicit reasoning, it often produces extended silent intervals that make the system appear unresponsive.
We refer to such user-audible dead air as unmasked silence, i.e., intervals during which internal reasoning is still ongoing but no speech is available to the user.
Such silence can last many seconds for complex queries, disrupting turn-taking and weakening conversational synchrony.
blocks.zh:
然而,基于推理的口语互动带来了暂时性-准确性紧张.
一个直截了当的方法是在发言前进行全文推理,然后提出最后的口头答复。
虽然这种连续的“思索时语”范式可以保留明确推理的好处,但它往往产生长时间的无声间隔,使系统看起来没有反应.
我们把这种用户可听到的死气称为无假声,即内部推理仍在进行,但用户无法发言的间隔时间。
这样的沉默对于复杂的询问可以持续多秒,会打乱转弯并削弱对话同步.

blocks.en:
This work focuses on spoken agents that require non-trivial internal reasoning, such as multi-step reasoning, knowledge-intensive question answering, tutoring, and task-oriented assistance.
For short conversational exchanges, explicitly verbalizing intermediate reasoning may be unnecessary or even undesirable.
Our goal is to improve interaction in scenarios where the model requires additional reasoning time.
In such cases, short and task-grounded progress feedback can be preferable to prolonged silence.
Therefore, we study how to reduce unmasked silence during spoken reasoning and knowledge-intensive question answering while preserving the answer quality of a serial “think-then-speak” baseline without exposing raw reasoning traces.
blocks.zh:
这项工作侧重于需要非三角内部推理的口语代理,如多步骤推理,知识密集型问答,辅导,和面向任务的援助.
对于简短的谈话交流,明确口头的中间推理可能是不必要的,甚至不可取的.
我们的目标是在模型需要额外推理时间的情况下改善互动。
在这种情况下,短期和基于任务的进展反馈比长期沉默更为可取。
因此,我们研究如何减少口语推理和知识密集型问题回答过程中的沉默,同时在不暴露原始推理痕迹的情况下,保持连续“思索时语”基线的答案质量。

blocks.en:
We borrow the term “thinking aloud” from cognitive psychology and protocol analysis ( Ericsson and Simon, 1984 ; Newell and Simon, 1972 ) , but use it for a different research purpose.
In this work, think-aloud responses are short intermediate utterances generated during the model’s reasoning phase to provide audible progress feedback.
They are not intended to expose the full chain of thought.
Instead, they provide concise signals such as a task reformulation, an intermediate reasoning milestone, or a transition cue, while the main reasoning process continues in the background.
blocks.zh:
我们从认知心理学和协议分析中借用“大声思考”一词(爱立信和西蒙,1984年;纽厄尔和西蒙,1972年),但将其用于不同的研究目的。
在这项工作中,思维声响的反应是模型推理阶段产生的简短中间语句,以提供可见的进展反馈。
其目的不是要揭露整个思想链。
相反,它们提供了简洁的信号,如任务重构,中间推理里程碑,或过渡提示等,而主要推理过程则在背景中继续.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 1 , our paradigm initiates simultaneous processing upon receiving user input.
A reasoning stream performs textual deduction, while a speaking stream produces selected think-aloud utterances conditioned on the user input and, when available, the evolving reasoning state.
The system first generates an initial utterance to bridge the start-up gap, retaining the key benefit of generic fillers such as “Let me think”: providing immediate audible feedback before the final answer is ready.
Different from a fixed filler, however, this utterance is grounded in the user’s query and acknowledges the specific task being addressed.
blocks.zh:
如图1所示,我们的模式是在接收用户输入时同时启动处理。
推理流进行文字推理,而说话流则产生以用户输入和在可用时不断发展的推理状态为条件的选定的思维声优。
该系统首先产生填补启动缺口的初步言论,保留“让我想想”等通用填充器的关键好处:在最后答复准备好之前立即提供可听到的反馈。
然而,与固定填充器不同,这种表述是基于用户的查询,并承认正在处理的具体任务。

blocks.en:
As reasoning progresses, intermediate milestones can trigger additional speech segments.
These later utterances further provide lightweight, task-grounded progress cues while continuing to mask long silent intervals.
Unlike fixed chunk-level interleaving, this paradigm decouples reasoning progression from speech realization.
The reasoning stream can continue advancing the main reasoning trajectory, while the speaking stream verbalizes only selected progress signals.
blocks.zh:
随着推理的进步,中间里程碑可以触发额外的语音段.
这些后来的言论进一步提供了轻量级、基于任务的进展提示,同时继续掩盖了长时间的无声间隔。
与固定块级互离不同,这种范式脱钩推理从语音实现中发展.
推理流可以继续推进主要推理轨迹,而说话流则只将选定的进度信号口头化.

blocks.en:
To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce a framework based on the Thinker-Talker architecture.
The framework includes a lightweight think-aloud module that coordinates with the main reasoning thinker.
The reasoning thinker generates the internal reasoning trajectory and emits think-aloud trigger tokens at selected reasoning milestones.
The think-aloud module then produces concise intermediate utterances, which are synthesized by a unified talker.
During inference, a dynamic balance strategy decides when additional think-aloud speech should be generated or canceled.
blocks.zh:
为了即兴发挥这个范式,我们引入了一个基于"智者-塔尔克"架构的框架.
框架包括一个轻量级的思维-声乐模块,与主要推理者相协调.
推理思考者在选定的推理里程碑上生成内部推理轨迹并发出思维-aloud触发符.
思想-aloud模块然后产生简明的中间语句,由统一的谈话者合成.
在推论期间,动态平衡战略决定何时应产生或取消额外的思维声波演说。

blocks.en:
In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We introduce an asynchronous think-aloud framework that provides timely spoken feedback during reasoning, starting with a brief acknowledgement of the user’s request and followed by concise, reasoning-grounded progress updates at selected milestones, without verbalizing the full reasoning trace. • We introduce a lightweight think-aloud module within the Thinker-Talker architecture and design a dynamic balance strategy to coordinate reasoning and speaking at runtime.
The strategy triggers additional think-aloud speech when silence emerges and cancels pending utterances when the final response becomes ready, reducing both unmasked silence and unnecessary articulation computational overhead after the reasoning completes. • Experiments on spoken reasoning and question-answering benchmarks show that our approach substantially reduces unmasked silence while maintaining performance comparable to a serial “think-then-speak” baseline across both evaluation categories.
These results support more responsive spoken interaction.
blocks.zh:
简而言之,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们采用一个同步的思维-声响框架,在推理过程中及时提供口头反馈,首先是简短地承认用户的要求,然后在选定的里程碑上进行简明的、以推理为基础的进度更新,同时不辱骂充分推理的痕迹。 我们在思维-塔尔克架构中引入了一个轻量级思维-声乐模块,并设计了动态平衡策略,以便在运行时协调推理和演讲.
当沉默出现时,这一策略引发了更多的有思想声的言论,并在最后答复准备就绪时,取消待发的言论,在推理完成后,既会减少无声的沉默,又会减少不必要的表达计算间接费用。 · 关于口语推理和问答基准的实验表明,我们的做法大大减少了无遮掩的沉默,同时保持业绩与两个评价类别连续的“思索时说”基线相当。
这些成果支持更能回应的口头互动。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
We propose a unified architecture that separates internal reasoning from audible progress-feedback generation while coordinating them asynchronously in reasoning-based SLMs.
As shown in Figure 2 , the architecture comprises three jointly optimized components: the reasoning thinker, the think-aloud module, and the unified talker.
We further propose a dynamic balance algorithm to align reasoning latency with think-aloud response duration during inference.
blocks.zh:
我们建议建立一个统一的架构,将内部推理与可听到的进步反馈生成区分开来,同时在基于推理的可持续土地管理中同步协调它们。
如图2所示,该架构由三个共同优化的构件组成:推理思考器,思维-阿卢德模块,以及统一的谈话器.
我们进一步提出了一个动态平衡算法,以使推理时间与推理期间的思维-声响反应时间相配合。

blocks.en: 2.1 The Reasoning Thinker
blocks.zh: 2.1 理性思考者

blocks.en:
The reasoning thinker serves as the cognitive core of our system.
It accepts the system prompt and the audio representations labeled as “User Hidden 1” in Figure 2 from the audio encoder as input.
Similar to text-based LLMs with reasoning capabilities ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Wei et al., 2022 ) , the reasoning thinker first generates a reasoning trajectory.
Subsequently, prior to generating the final response, the think-aloud responses produced by the think-aloud module are appended to the reasoning context.
This ensures that the final response remains consistent with the think-aloud content, facilitating a more coherent generation process.

推理思想家是我们系统认知核心.
它接受系统提示,音频编码器中标为“用户隐藏1”的音频表示作为输入。
与有推理能力的以文字为基础的LLMS类似(Guo等,2025;Wei等,2022),推理思考者首先产生推理轨迹.
随后,在生成最后回复之前,由思维-aloud模块生成的思维-声波响应被附在推理上下文后.
这确保了最后的对策与思想 -- -- 大声 -- -- 的内容保持一致,促进更协调一致的生成过程。

blocks.en:
Let 𝐇 u ​ s ​ e ​ r \mathbf{H}^{user} denote the sequence of hidden state representations corresponding to the user input, which is labeled as “User Hidden 2” in Figure 2 .
To address the latency associated with reasoning generation, we employ a special token, <TA_trigger> , to activate the think-aloud module.
Immediately upon processing 𝐇 u ​ s ​ e ​ r \mathbf{H}^{user} , the reasoning thinker generates the first <TA_trigger> , prompting the think-aloud module to produce an initial response before the reasoning process commences.
As the thinker proceeds to generate the reasoning trajectory, it predicts additional <TA_trigger> tokens at specific positions, allowing the think-aloud module to update its response based on the evolving reasoning context.
Crucially, the reasoning thinker and the think-aloud module operate asynchronously; the thinker continues to generate subsequent reasoning tokens in the background, running in parallel with the think-aloud module.

Generic fillers such as “Let me think” are a simple and effective way to mask the initial silence in spoken interaction.
Our framework retains this advantage through the first forced think-aloud trigger, which is generated immediately after the user query and functions as a brief acknowledgement of the user query rather than a fixed template filler.
This first utterance plays a filler-like role: it provides fast audible feedback before the main reasoning trajectory is completed.

像“让我想一想”这样的通用填充词是掩盖口头互动中最初沉默的简单而有效的方法。
我们的框架通过第一个强制思维-声响触发器保留这一优势,该触发器是在用户查询后立即产生的,其功能是对用户查询的简短确认,而不是固定的模板填充器.
这首初语扮演了类似填充器的角色:在主要推理轨迹完成前提供快速可听取的反馈.

blocks.en:
Later think-aloud utterances extend this mechanism beyond initial silence masking. Instead of repeatedly producing generic fillers, they are conditioned on the evolving reasoning state and triggered at selected reasoning milestones.
In this sense, the proposed framework can be interpreted as a hybrid feedback policy: it combines the low-latency silence-masking role of fillers with reasoning-grounded progress feedback for longer reasoning turns.

后来的思潮声将这种机制扩展到了最初的沉默掩盖之外。 它们不重复生产通用填充器,而是以不断发展的推理状态为条件,并在选定的推理里程碑上被触发.
从这个意义上讲,拟议框架可以被解释为一种混合反馈政策:它结合了填充者的低常态沉默-伪装角色和基于推理的进展反馈,用于较长的推理转折.

blocks.en: 2.5 Dynamic Balance Strategy

blocks.en: During training, the model learns to trigger appropriate think-aloud responses based on reasoning milestones, as described in Section 3 . However, during real-time streaming inference, the physical duration of synthesized speech may not align with the varying computation time required for reasoning generation. To reduce long silent gaps and excessive articulation computational overhead, we introduce a state-driven dynamic balance strategy to coordinate the asynchronous reasoning (Thinker) and speaking (think-aloud module) streams.
blocks.zh: 如第3节所描述,在培训期间,该模式学会根据推理里程碑触发适当的思维声响反应。 然而,在实时流推中,合成语音的物理持续时间可能与推理生成所需的不同计算时间不一致. 为了减少长期无声的缺口和过度表达的计算间接费用,我们引入了由国家驱动的动态平衡策略来协调同步推理(Thinker)和说话(think-aloud模块)流.

blocks.en: Rather than relying on pre-computed time estimates, the proposed strategy tracks the runtime states of both streams and is invoked at key transition events, e.g., when the currently active think-aloud playback finishes while reasoning is still ongoing, or when the reasoning stream reaches completion. It handles two primary boundary scenarios:
blocks.zh: 拟议的战略不是依靠预先计算的时间估计,而是跟踪两个流的运行时间状态,并在关键的过渡活动中被引用,例如当当前活跃的思维-声响回放在推理仍在进行时完成,或者当推理流达到完成时. 它处理两种主要边界情况:

blocks.en:
• Audio starvation (reasoning is ongoing, but speech playback has finished): This occurs when the reasoning process is still generating tokens, but no think-aloud audio remains for playback.
To reduce user-perceived silence, the strategy scans the current reasoning buffer for the latest completed logical segment that has not yet triggered a response, using the same double-newline-based segment boundary convention as in training.
It then issues a new think-aloud trigger for that segment, providing additional audible feedback while reasoning continues. • Reasoning early completion (reasoning finishes while think-aloud is ongoing): This occurs when the thinker completes its deduction before all potential think-aloud responses have been synthesized.
To produce the final response, the strategy immediately cancels all pending (i.e., not yet synthesized) <TA_trigger> tokens. The currently active think-aloud utterance, however, is allowed to finish before final-response generation begins. The completed utterance is appended to the reasoning context so that the subsequent final response remains consistent with the speech already presented to the user.

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the methodology for preparing our reasoning and “think-aloud” datasets using in-house SFT data, which contains both single-turn and multi-turn spoken dialogue data.

blocks.en: 3.1 Reasoning Data Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 产生数据的理由

blocks.en:
Our reasoning data is generated through a three-step pipeline using DeepSeek-R1 ( Guo et al., 2025 ) for all generation and filtering. • We first identify and select reasoning-intensive turns from the in-house SFT data.
We evaluate each turn five times using the identical prompt, and the result is determined by a majority vote. • Second, we prompt DeepSeek-R1 with the dialogue history and the current user input for each selected turn.
We then extract the resulting reasoning text while discarding the model’s final reply. • Finally, we validate the generated reasoning text.
Since the extracted reasoning text is conditioned only on the dialogue history and user input, its alignment with the final ground-truth answer is not guaranteed.
Therefore, we apply an additional filtering pass to ensure this consistency and filter out any mismatches.
Similar to the first step, we run five times using the same prompt and decide the answer by a majority vote.

blocks.en: 3.2 Think-Aloud Response Generation

blocks.en:
For the generation of think-aloud responses, we employ a process with four steps.
All steps use the DeepSeek-R1 model ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . • First, the reasoning text is segmented into multiple paragraphs using double newline characters as delimiters.
Following segmentation, we identify potential trigger points for the think-aloud responses.
Our criterion is whether a preliminary conclusion can be drawn from the reasoning content of the current segment.
To ensure the stability of this process and filter out spurious triggers, the identification routine is executed five times, and the final set of triggers is determined via a majority vote. • Once the triggers are finalized, the model generates the think-aloud responses.
This generation is conditioned on both the original user input and the specific reasoning content associated with the validated trigger points.
We intentionally restrict each think-aloud response to a single sentence to keep the verbalized reasoning concise, controllable in duration, and less likely to dominate the final answer during response generation. • In the third step, we prompt DeepSeek-R1 to minimally rewrite the original final response conditioned on the generated think-aloud utterances, ensuring consistency with the audible progress feedback while preserving the original answer semantics. • Finally, we utilize the internal TTS to resynthesize speech for all responses, ensuring acoustic consistency across the dataset.
This process covers the entire dialogue history, the think-aloud response, and the final responses.
All generated speech segments are unified into a single-speaker voice.

一旦触发器最终确定,模型就产生出"想声"的响应.
这个生成以原始用户输入以及与被验证的触发点相关的具体推理内容为条件.
我们有意将每个思想声响的反应限制在一个句子内,使口语化的推理保持简洁,可控的持续时间,在反应生成过程中不太可能主导最后的答案.

blocks.en: In the third step, we prompt DeepSeek-R1 to minimally rewrite the original final response conditioned on the generated think-aloud utterances, ensuring consistency with the audible progress feedback while preserving the original answer semantics.
blocks.zh: 在第三步中,我们促使DeepSeek-R1在生成的思维-声波发音上,尽可能地重写最初的最终响应,确保与可调取的进展反馈保持一致,同时保留原始的答案语义.

blocks.en:
Finally, we utilize the internal TTS to resynthesize speech for all responses, ensuring acoustic consistency across the dataset.
This process covers the entire dialogue history, the think-aloud response, and the final responses.
All generated speech segments are unified into a single-speaker voice.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们利用内部的TTS对所有响应的语音进行再合成,确保整个数据集的声学一致性.
这一进程涵盖整个对话历史、思想和声响的反应以及最后的反应。
所有所生成的语音段被统一为一个单声道语音.

blocks.en: The prompts for trigger identification, utterance generation, and final-response rewriting are provided in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 触发识别、语音生成和最后反应重写提示载于附录A.2。

blocks.zh: 浮点心

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Data

We utilize a large-scale proprietary in-house dataset comprising approximately 200,000 single- and multi-turn dialogues, totaling around 5,000 hours of speech.
Due to data governance and privacy restrictions, the training corpus cannot be publicly released.
To provide context on the data distribution, these dialogues span diverse scenarios, including general commonsense QA, reasoning and logical deduction, as well as general helpfulness queries.
This composition ensures the model’s coverage across diverse spoken-interaction scenarios.
The reasoning text and think-aloud responses are prepared following the methodology outlined in Section 3 .
To improve transparency, we provide the data-construction prompts in Appendix A , the evaluation protocols in Section 4.2 , and representative outputs in Section 5.5 .
blocks.zh:
我们使用一个大型的专有内部数据集,由大约20万个单回合和多回合对话组成,共计约5 000个小时的发言时间。
由于数据管理和隐私限制,培训大纲不能公开发布。
为了提供数据分布的背景,这些对话涉及各种情况,包括一般常识QA、推理和逻辑推理,以及一般的有用性查询。
这种构成确保了该模型涵盖各种不同的口语互动情景。
推理案文和有创意的答复是按照第3节概述的方法编写的。
为了提高透明度,我们在附录A中提供了数据构建提示,在第4.2节中提供了评价协议,在第5.5节中提供了具有代表性的产出。

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Model Training
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 示范培训

blocks.en:
For model initialization, we leverage several pre-trained models.
The audio encoder and reasoning thinker are initialized from the Qwen2.5-Omni-7B ( Xu et al., 2025 ) thinker model and audio encoder.
The think-aloud module is initialized with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2024 ) .
The unified talker and streaming codec decoder, which are responsible for generating the final audio, are initialized using the CosyVoice 2.0 LLM and the flow matching model ( Du et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
对于模型初始化,我们利用几个预先训练过的模型.
音频编码和推理思维器由Quen2.5-Omni-7B(徐等,2025年)思维器模型和音频编码器初始化.
思想-aloud模块以Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct(杨等,2024.
负责生成最终音频的统一收发器和流码解码器被初始化使用CosyVoice 2.0 LLM和流量匹配模型(Du等,2024.

blocks.en:
The model is trained for 10,000 steps on 64 H100 GPUs using a batch size of 64.
We employ a learning rate scheduler with a peak value of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , which includes a 500-step warm-up phase followed by an exponential decay.
During model training, we randomly select a turn containing reasoning data from the dialogue to designate as the final turn.
Concurrently, we randomly select either one of the think-aloud responses or the final system response to train the talker.
blocks.zh:
该型号在64个H100GPU上被训练出一万步,使用批量尺寸为64.
我们使用一个学习速率计时器,峰值为1×10−5 1\times 10×5}包括一个500步的取暖阶段,然后是指数衰减。
在模型训练中,我们随机选择一个回合,包含对话中的推理数据,指定为最后回合.
同时,我们随机选择一个思想-声响响应或者最后的系统响应来训练说话者.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate our models on two categories of datasets.
First, to assess reasoning capabilities, we utilize the single-step and multi-step reasoning subsets of the Spoken-MQA benchmark ( Wei et al., 2025 ) .
Correctness is assessed by a GPT-4o judge using a best-of-three majority voting strategy.
Second, to test commonsense knowledge and factuality, we use the Web Questions ( Berant et al., 2013 ) , and TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ) .
For this category, we apply the exact match to determine if the ground-truth answer is present in the model’s response.
The metric is accuracy for both the Web Questions and TriviaQA test set.
blocks.zh:
我们用两类数据集评估我们的模型。
首先,为了评估推理能力,我们利用了Spoken-MQA基准(Wei等,2025年)的单步和多步推理子集。
正确性由一名GPT-4o法官用三种最优多数投票策略来评估.
其次,为了测试常识知识和事实性,我们使用"网络问题"(Berant等,2013年)和"TriviaQA"(Joshi等,2017年).
对于这个类别,我们采用精确的匹配来确定模型的答复中是否有地面真实的答案。
衡量标准是Web Questions和TriviaQA测试集的准确性.

blocks.en: \FloatBarrier
blocks.zh: 浮点心

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要成果

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we benchmark against two control settings. The Baseline represents a model without the think-aloud module, fine-tuned solely on direct-response data, i.e., data that excludes intermediate reasoning steps. The Baseline with CoT uses the same backbone but is trained on datasets augmented with reasoning text. This model follows a serial paradigm, generating the full textual reasoning before synthesizing speech, and thus serves as a strong serial reasoning reference, albeit with substantially higher latency. Our proposed model is described as Baseline with Think-Aloud CoT .
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的方法的有效性,我们参照两种控制环境。 基线代表一个模型,没有思维声模块,只根据直接反应数据进行微调,即排除中间推理步骤的数据。 与CoT的基线使用同样的主干线,但受过关于数据集的培训,并增加了推理文本。 这个模型遵循了序列范式,在合成语音之前产生出完整的文字推理,从而成为了强烈的序列推理参考,尽管其延迟度要高得多. 我们提出的模式被描述为 " 与智者联盟的基线 " 。

blocks.en:
The two controls serve different purposes. The baseline represents a non-reasoning spoken assistant and is used to measure the gap between our full reasoning-enabled system and a direct-response spoken model.
The baseline with CoT is the more relevant design-level control, since it shares reasoning-augmented supervision with our method but follows a serial think-then-speak pipeline.
blocks.zh:
这两种控制服务于不同的目的。 基线代表一个不讲道理的口语助理,用来衡量我们完全基于推理的系统与直接回应口语模式之间的差距。
与CoT的基线是更相关的设计层面控制,因为它与我们的方法共享推理强化监督,但遵循的是串行式的思维式管道。

blocks.en:
Table 1 presents the evaluation results on the Spoken-MQA benchmark, which assesses the model’s ability to handle both single-hop and multi-hop reasoning in speech.
Compared with the direct-response baseline, our full system achieves substantially higher accuracy on reasoning-intensive tasks, especially on the multi-step subset. This comparison reflects the performance gap between a non-reasoning spoken assistant and our full reasoning-enabled system.
More importantly, when compared with the baseline with reasoning, our method achieves highly comparable performance (87.6% vs. 88.5% on average).
This suggests that our framework largely preserves the logical depth and answer accuracy of CoT reasoning, while avoiding the long silent delays of the serial paradigm.
blocks.zh:
表1介绍了Spoken-MQA基准的评价结果,该基准评估了该模型在语音中处理单跳和多跳推理的能力。
与直接反应基线相比,我们整个系统在推理密集型任务方面,特别是在多步骤子集方面,实现的精确度要高得多。 这种比较反映了一个不讲道理的口语助理与我们完全以推理为基础的系统之间的业绩差距。
更重要的是,与基于推理的基线相比,我们的方法取得了高度可比的业绩(平均87.6%对88.5%)。
这表明我们的框架在很大程度上保持了COT推理的逻辑深度和答案的准确性,同时避免了序列范式长期无声的拖延.

blocks.en: Table 1: Performance on single-step and multi-step reasoning subsets of Spoken-MQA benchmark, measured in accuracy.
blocks.zh: 表1:Spoken-MQA基准的单步和多步推理子集的性能,精确度测量.

blocks.en: We further evaluate general knowledge performance on the Web Questions and TriviaQA datasets under both Speech-to-Speech and Speech-to-Text settings (Table 2 ). Consistent with the findings on Spoken-MQA, our model outperforms the direct-response baseline by a clear margin (e.g., +5.4% average accuracy in S2S) and remains highly comparable to the baseline with reasoning. Taken together, these results suggest that concurrent think-aloud generation does not materially degrade the factual accuracy of the final response.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价网络问答和TriviaQA数据集在语音对语音和语音对文字设置下的一般知识表现(表2)。 与"Spoken-MQA"的结论一致,我们的模型性能以一个明确的比值(如S2S中+5.4%的平均精度)超过了直接反应基线,并且与基于推理的基线仍然高度可比较. 总而言之,这些结果表明,同时产生思想声不会在实质上降低最后答复的事实准确性。

blocks.en: Table 2: Speech-to-Speech and Speech-to-Text performance on spoken QA benchmarks, measured in accuracy.
blocks.zh: 表2:按口语质量评估基准的语音对语音和语音对文字的性能,精确度衡量。

blocks.en: Tables 1 and 2 also include results from recent state-of-the-art SLMs for reference. Although direct comparison is difficult due to differences in training data and experimental settings, the results indicate that our method remains competitive relative to contemporary spoken language models.
blocks.zh: 表1和表2还列有最近最先进的可持续土地管理的结果供参考。 虽然由于培训数据和实验环境的不同,直接比较是困难的,但结果表明,我们的方法相对于当代口语模式来说仍然具有竞争力。

blocks.en: \FloatBarrier
blocks.zh: 浮点心

blocks.en: 5.2 Latency Analyses
blocks.zh: 5.2 延迟分析

blocks.en: Table 3: Performance and latency analysis on the Spoken-MQA benchmark. “DB Stgy.” is short for dynamic balance strategy.
blocks.zh: 表3:Spoken-MQA基准的性能和耐久性分析。 “DB Stgy”是动态平衡战略的简称。

blocks.en:
In real-world deployments, SLMs may run under different hardware and software conditions, leading to varying reasoning speeds. A robust think-aloud mechanism should therefore adapt the duration of generated speech to the speed of internal reasoning.
We evaluate this temporal synchronization using two latency metrics: Unmasked Silence Latency ( L sil L_{\mathrm{sil}} ), the cumulative duration during which reasoning is ongoing but no audio feedback is available to the user, and Articulation Computational Overhead Latency ( L oh L_{\mathrm{oh}} ), the extra delay caused when think-aloud speech continues after the final response becomes ready.
blocks.zh:
在现实世界的部署中,可持续土地管理可能在不同的硬件和软件条件下运行,导致不同的推理速度. 因此,一个强有力的思维-声响机制应当使所产生的演讲时间与内部推理的速度相适应。
我们用两个耐久度度度来评估这种时间同步: Unmasked Silence Latency(L sil L_{\-mathrm{sil}}),即推理持续但用户无法获取音频反馈的累积持续时间,以及Articulation Concational Overhead Latency(Loh L_{\-mat-mathrm{oh}}),在最后回复准备好后,思想声波的演讲持续了所引发的额外延迟.

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 3 , the serial reasoning baseline achieves competitive accuracy but suffers from a large ( L sil L_{\mathrm{sil}} ) of 12.82s, making it less suitable for fluid spoken interaction.
In contrast, the ablation without the dynamic balance strategy substantially reduces silence but produces a large ( L oh L_{\mathrm{oh}} ) of 19.92s, indicating that unregulated think-aloud generation can unnecessarily prolong the turn.
Our full model achieves a better trade-off across different reasoning speeds.
Unless otherwise specified, the main latency results are reported under a reasoning generation speed of 40 tok/s.
By dynamically triggering or canceling think-aloud utterances, the proposed strategy suppresses both unmasked silence and articulation computational overhead while maintaining accuracy comparable to the serial reasoning baseline.
blocks.zh:
如表3所示,序列推理基线实现了竞争的精度,但遇到了12.82s的较大(L sil L_{\-mathrm{sil}}),使其更不适合流体口语交互.
相反,没有动态平衡战略的衰减会大大地减少沉默,但会产生19.92s的庞大(L oh oh ox-mathrm{oh}}),这表明不受管制的智障一代可能会不必要地延长转折.
我们的完整模式可以实现不同推理速度之间更好的取舍。
除非另有说明,主要延迟结果在推理生成速度为40克/秒下报告.
通过动态地触发或取消思想呼声,拟议战略压制了未露面的沉默和阐明的计算间接费用,同时保持与序列推理基线相仿的准确性。

blocks.en: To further analyze the temporal behavior, Figure 3 visualizes reasoning duration and perceived latency on the multi-step subset of Spoken-MQA, with samples sorted by reasoning duration. The shaded region indicates the amount of reasoning time masked by think-aloud speech. For most samples, the proposed mechanism keeps perceived latency very low even when the reasoning duration is long, although a small number of outliers still exhibit noticeable wait time.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步分析时间行为,图3将推理持续时间和感知到Spoken-MQA的多步骤子集上,样本按推理持续时间排序. 阴影区域表示被思想-声波演说所掩盖的推理时间. 对大多数样本来说,拟议的机制即使推理时间很长,仍保持很低的暂时性,尽管少数异常值仍然显示出明显的等待时间。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 also illustrates why the proposed mechanism is not merely an initial filler.
A single short filler can only mask the beginning of a long reasoning interval.
Repeated generic fillers could further reduce silence, but they would still provide limited information about the task or the model’s progress.
Our dynamic triggering mechanism preserves the silence-masking role of fillers while replacing repeated task-independent phrases with progress utterances conditioned on completed reasoning segments.
blocks.zh:
图3还说明了拟议机制为何不仅仅是初步填充机制。
单个短的填充器只能掩盖长推理间隔的开始.
重复使用通用填充器可以进一步减少沉默,但是它们仍能提供关于任务或模型进展的有限信息。
我们的动态触发机制保留了填充器的默默装模作样的作用,同时将重复的任务独立的短语取而代之的是以已完成的推理部分为条件的进展表述.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Impact of think-aloud utterances on perceived latency. Samples are sorted by reasoning duration. The blue line shows reasoning duration, the green line shows perceived latency, and the shaded region indicates the silence reduced by think-aloud speech. The results show that the proposed mechanism substantially masks reasoning time and keeps perceived latency low for most samples, even when reasoning takes longer.
blocks.zh: 图3:思想声波言论对预期延迟的影响。 样本按推理持续时间排序. 蓝线显示推理持续时间,绿线显示感知到的耐久性,而被遮蔽的区域则表示被想声演说所减少的沉默. 结果显示,拟议的机制在很大程度上掩盖了推理时间,使大多数样本的认知延迟度一直很低,即使推理需要更长的时间。

blocks.en: \FloatBarrier
blocks.zh: 浮点心

blocks.en: 5.3 Speech Quality
blocks.zh: 5.3 语音质量

blocks.en:
To evaluate speech quality, we compare our model with Qwen2.5-Omni ( Xu et al., 2025 ) on the single-step reasoning subset of the Spoken-MQA benchmark ( Wei et al., 2025 ) .
We utilize four metrics: STOI, PESQ, SI-SDR, and NISQA.
The first three metrics are estimated using TorchAudio-Squim ( Kumar et al., 2023 ) .
As shown in Table 4 , higher scores indicate better performance.
blocks.zh:
为了评价语音质量,我们用"Spoken-MQA"基准的单步推理子集(Wei等,2025年)与Quen2.5-Omni(徐等,2025年)比较我们的模型.
我们使用四个标准:STOI、PESQ、SI-SDR和NISQA。
前三个衡量标准是使用火炬Audio-Squim(Kumar等,2023年)估算的。
如表4所示,较高的分数表明业绩较好。

blocks.en:
Overall, the proposed model achieves intelligibility comparable to that of Qwen2.5-Omni.
However, it provides better perceptual quality, improving PESQ from 3.69 to 3.97 and NISQA from 4.65 to 4.95.
Conversely, the SI-SDR score is slightly lower for the proposed model.
Taken together, these results demonstrate that the speech quality of our model is comparable to that of Qwen2.5-Omni.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,拟议的模型实现了与Qun2.5-Omni相似的可知性。
然而,它提供了更好的认知质量,将PESQ从3.69提高到了3.97,将NISQA从4.65提高到了4.95。
反之,SI-SDR的分数对于所拟议的模型来说略低.
综合这些结果显示,我们模型的语音质量与Quen2.5-Omni相当。

blocks.en: Table 4: Performance in terms of speech quality of Qwen2.5-Omni and our proposed model on the single-step reasoning subset of spoken-MQA benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表4:Quen2.5-Omni的语音质量表现和我们提议的口语-MQA基准单步推理子集模型。

blocks.en: \FloatBarrier
blocks.zh: 浮点心

blocks.en: 5.4 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.4 人类评价

blocks.en:
To complement the objective evaluations, we conduct a human evaluation on 50 randomly sampled test cases from the multi-step subset of Spoken-MQA benchmark, with 3 annotators per case.
For each sample, annotators compare the output from our proposed model with the output that remains silent during thinking and only outputs the final response.
In a blind A/B setting, they are asked to choose (1) which system they prefer overall and (2) which system feels more responsive.
In addition, they rate the fluency/naturalness of the proposed model output on a 5-point Likert scale (1: very unnatural, 3: Acceptable, 5: very natural).
blocks.zh:
为了补充客观评价,我们对50个随机抽取的测试案例进行了人类评价,这些案例来自Spoken-MQA基准的多步骤子集,每个案例有3名注释员。
对于每个样本,注释者将我们拟议模型的产出与在思考期间保持沉默且仅输出最后反应的产出进行比较。
在盲目的A/B环境下,他们被要求选择(1)他们喜欢哪种系统,以及(2)哪个系统感觉更具有响应性.
此外,它们还按5分的相似度(非常不自然,3:可接受,5:非常自然)来评定拟议模型输出的流利度/自然度.

blocks.en:
The proposed model is preferred overall in 85.3% of the cases and is judged to be more responsive in 99.3% of the cases, while achieving a fluency/naturalness score of 4.01.
Qualitatively, we observe that the inserted think-aloud responses are generally consistent with the final responses, and the transition to the final answer is typically smooth rather than abruptly cut off.
Representative qualitative examples are provided in Section 5.5 .
blocks.zh:
总体来说,85.3%的案件倾向于采用拟议模式,99.3%的案件被认为反应更灵敏,而流利/自然得分为4.01。
从质量上讲,我们注意到,插入的思想-声波反应一般与最后反应一致,向最后反应的过渡一般是平稳的,而不是突然中断的.
第5.5节提供了有代表性的定性实例。

blocks.en: 5.5 Qualitative Examples
blocks.zh: 5.5 定性实例

blocks.en: We present a standard operating example and a separate illustrative future-use scenario.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个标准操作范例和一个单独的说明未来用途的设想。

blocks.en: 5.5.1 Standard Think-Aloud Operation
blocks.zh: 5.5.1 标准 思维-大声行动

blocks.en:
Figure 4 illustrates the standard operating mode of the proposed model.
During the thinker reasoning process, a total of three <TA_trigger> s are generated.
At the current reasoning speed, the first utterance is sufficient to cover the reasoning period, so the second and third triggers are canceled by the dynamic balance strategy.
Instead of remaining silent for a long period and then producing a direct answer, the system first generates a think-aloud response, reducing the silent gap between the query and the final solution before delivering the final response.
blocks.zh:
图4说明了拟议模式的标准作业程序。
在思想者推理过程中,总共生成了3个"TA_trigger" s.
在目前的推理速度下,第一句话足以涵盖推理期,因此第二和第三个触发被动态平衡策略所取消.
系统不是长时间保持沉默,然后产生出直接的答案,而是首先生成出一个想声的响应,在发送最终响应之前缩短了询问和最终解决方案之间的沉默差距.

blocks.en:
Figure 4: Case 1 demonstrates thinking while speaking. Ay Gray backgrounds represent User Input. Ay Light Blue denotes the think-aloud responses, while Ay Dark Blue highlights the final response derived from the reasoning process.
The <TA_trigger> with a strike-through indicates that the trigger is canceled by the dynamic balance strategy.
blocks.zh:
图4:案例1显示了发言时的思维。 Ay Gray背景代表用户输入. Ay Light Blue表示思想-aloud反应,而Ay Dark Blue则强调由推理过程衍生出的最终反应.
带有打击通路的"TA_trigger"表示触发被动态平衡策略所取消.

blocks.en: 5.5.2 Simulated Interruption for Error Correction
blocks.zh: 5.5.2 错误更正模拟中断

blocks.en:
Figure 5 illustrates a possible deployment setting in which exposed think-aloud speech may allow earlier user intervention when an error is detected in the reasoning stream.
It is included as an illustrative future-use scenario rather than as a validated capability of the current system.
The scenario assumes an external interruption mechanism, such as VAD or turn-taking control, which is outside the scope of this work and is not implemented or quantitatively evaluated here.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: 6.1 Spoken Language Models
blocks.zh: 6.1 语音语言模型

blocks.en:
Existing SLMs typically generate speech through either interleaved text-speech decoding ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ) or the Thinker-Talker architecture ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) .
In the interleaved paradigm, the backbone alternately generates text and speech chunks, where text serves as a transcription that guides subsequent audio.
In the Thinker-Talker paradigm, a thinker first produces text and intermediate representations, which a talker then converts into speech tokens. Despite these differences, both paradigms tightly couple generated text with speech output, effectively treating text as a script for synthesis.
Our work instead equips the SLM with intrinsic reasoning capabilities and introduces a dedicated think-aloud module that verbalizes selected reasoning-grounded milestones as natural progress utterances during inference.
blocks.zh:
现有的可持续土地管理通常通过互换文本-语音解码(Zeng等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年b)或思考者-塔尔克架构(Xu等人,2025年;Ding等人,2025年;Fang等人,2025年)产生语音。
在相隔的范式中,主干部分交替生成文本和语音块,其中文本充当了引导后继音频的转录.
在"思想家-塔尔克"范式中,思想家首先会制作出文字和中间表述,然后由说话者转换成语音符号. 尽管存在这些差异,两种范式都紧紧地结合了语音输出生成了文本,有效地将文本作为合成的脚本.
我们的工作反而使可持续土地管理具备了内在的推理能力,并引入了一个专门的思维-声响模块,将某些推理的里程碑说成是在推论中自然进步的。

blocks.en:
A separate line of work targets full-duplex spoken interaction, where the model can listen and speak simultaneously.
Systems such as Moshi ( Défossez et al., 2024 ) use parallel audio streams to support barge-in and overlapping speech.
These approaches improve responsiveness along the listen-while-speak dimension, whereas our framework targets a different source of latency: the internal reasoning delay after a user query has been received.
We therefore study the complementary think-while-speak dimension, where a primary reasoning stream continues in the background while a speaking stream provides audible progress feedback.
Our current system does not address barge-in directly, but its decoupled reasoning-and-speaking design could be integrated with full-duplex audio interfaces in future work.
blocks.zh:
单独的一行工作目标为全复式口语互动,模式可以同时听和说话.
Moshi等系统(Défossez等,2024年)使用平行的音频流支持驳入和重叠的语音.
这些办法提高了听力和语能方面的响应能力,而我们的框架针对的是另一个延迟来源:在收到用户查询后的内部推理延迟。
因此,我们研究一个补充性的思想和语言层面,在这一层面,主要推理流在背景中继续,而发言流则提供明显的进展反馈。
我们目前的系统并不直接解决驳入问题,但其脱钩的推理和语言设计可在未来工作中与全复式音频接口相融合.

blocks.en: 6.2 Reasoning in Spoken Language Models
blocks.zh: 6.2 语法模型中的理由

blocks.en:
Integrating CoT reasoning into SLMs remains challenging, as it requires balancing reasoning capability, modality alignment, and low-latency interaction.
Early efforts ( Xie et al., 2025a ; Wen et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ) primarily study reasoning over audio or speech inputs in text-centric settings, while the problem of maintaining fluid spoken interaction during long reasoning remains less explored.
To mitigate this issue, recent approaches such as STITCH and Mini-Omni-Reasoner ( Chiang et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025b ) reduce latency by interleaving reasoning and spoken-response generation during inference, allowing intermediate reasoning to be incorporated while speech is produced incrementally.
These methods typically realize thinking and speaking within a predefined interleaved generation schedule, such as chunk-level alternation or token-level interleaving.
blocks.zh:
将综合技术论证纳入可持续土地管理仍然具有挑战性,因为它需要平衡推理能力、模式调整和低相关性互动。
早期努力 (谢等,2025a; Wen等,2025;Li等,2025a)主要研究以文字为中心环境中音频或语音输入的推理,而长推理期间保持流畅的口语互动的问题仍然较少被探讨.
为了减轻这一问题,最近的一些办法,如STITCH和Mini-Omni-Reasoner(Chiang等,2025;Xie等,2025b),通过在推论期间的离异推理和口语响应生成来减少暂时性,使得中间推理能够被融入其中,同时逐步生成语音.
这些方法通常在预定义的相叶生成时间表内实现思维和说话,如块级相接或符号级相接.

blocks.en:
Related parallel-processing paradigms have also been explored.
For example, Shih et al. (2025) propose a Thinking-while-Listening framework that reduces response delay by initiating text-based reasoning before the user has finished speaking.
AsyncVoice Agent ( Lin et al., 2025 ) similarly explores asynchronous voice interaction with live reasoning streams, but focuses on an external reasoning backend and an interruptible explanation interface rather than an integrated spoken language model.
blocks.zh:
还探讨了相关的平行处理模式。
例如,Shih等人(2025年)提出了一个思考-同时倾听的框架,通过在用户发言结束前启动基于文本的推理来减少响应延迟.
AsyncVoice Agent (Lin等,2025年)同样探索了与活推理流的同步语音互动,但专注于外部推理后端和可中断的解释界面,而不是综合口语模式.

blocks.en:
In a related but distinct direction, our framework focuses on thinking while speaking: it adopts a two-stream asynchronous design in which a reasoning thinker continuously advances the main reasoning trajectory, while a separate think-aloud module verbalizes selected reasoning milestones for a unified talker to synthesize.
By explicitly decoupling reasoning progression from speech delivery, our approach enables the two streams to proceed concurrently, rather than following a predefined chunk-level or token-level interleaving schedule.
blocks.zh:
在一个相关但截然不同的方向上,我们的框架在说话时注重思考:它采用一种双流同步设计,其中推理思考者不断推进主要推理轨迹,而一个单独的思维-aloud模块则将某些推理里程碑语言化,供统一说话者合成.
通过明确将推理过程与语音表达脱钩,我们的方法使两个流程能够同时进行,而不是遵循预先确定的块级或符号级的离合时间表。

blocks.en:
This design should not be interpreted as universally superior to interleaving-based approaches.
Instead, it represents a complementary architectural trade-off.
Fixed chunk-level or token-level interleaving provides a direct and effective mechanism for incremental generation, whereas our decoupled design aims to offer more flexible runtime scheduling when reasoning duration and speech duration are mismatched.
Crucially, guided by a dynamic balance strategy, our system can adapt to varying inference speeds by triggering additional progress speech under audio starvation or canceling pending utterances when the final response becomes ready, without relying on a fixed generation ratio.
As a result, the proposed Think-Aloud mechanism provides selected reasoning-grounded progress feedback as speech, reducing prolonged silent gaps and improving the responsiveness of spoken interaction across diverse deployment conditions.
A direct empirical comparison between asynchronous two-stream decoupling and interleaving-based spoken reasoning remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
这种设计不应被解释为普遍优于离休办法。
相反,它是一种互补的建筑取舍。
固定块级或符号级互离为递增生成提供了直接而有效的机制,而我们的脱钩设计则旨在在推理时间和演讲时间不匹配时提供更灵活的运行时间时间安排.
关键是,在动态平衡战略的指导下,我们的系统能够适应不同的推论速度,在音频饥饿下引发更多进展演说,或者在最后反应准备就绪时取消有待发表的讲话,而不依赖固定的生成比率。
因此,拟议的 " Think-Aloud " 机制以发言的形式提供某些基于推理的进展反馈,减少长期无声的差距,并改进不同部署条件的口头互动的反应能力。
将同步的双流脱钩和基于离休的口语推理进行直接的经验性比较,仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we presented an asynchronous think-aloud framework to address the tension between reasoning latency and responsiveness in spoken interaction.
By coordinating a primary reasoning stream with a lightweight think-aloud stream, our framework provides selected reasoning-grounded progress feedback while internal reasoning continues in the background.
Experiments show that the proposed method substantially reduces unmasked silence and improves turn responsiveness, while preserving most of the reasoning benefits of a serial think-then-speak system.
Overall, our method provides a practical design framework for building more responsive spoken reasoning agents.
Future work will study controlled comparisons with generic fillers, fully interactive user evaluation, and adaptive policies that shorten or skip reasoning when unnecessary.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提出了一个同步的思维-声响框架,以解决口语互动中推理延迟与反应之间的紧张关系。
我们的框架通过协调一个主要推理流和一个轻量级的思维-声波流,提供了一些基于推理的进展反馈,而内部推理则在背景中继续.
实验显示,所拟议的方法会大量地减少未露面的沉默并改进转弯反应能力,同时保留了串行思维时语系的大部分推理好处.
总的来说,我们的方法为建设更能回应的口语推理代理人提供了一个实用的设计框架.
今后的工作将研究与通用填充器进行有控制的比较,充分互动的用户评价,以及在不必要的情况下缩短或跳过推理的适应性政策。
